description: React component for an unarchive channel modal dialog in Mattermost, handling UI and unarchive action.

classes.name: UnarchiveChannelModal
classes.description: React component for unarchive channel modal dialog, managing visibility and unarchive action.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with show: true.

methods.name: handleUnarchive
methods.description: Handles unarchive action, calls external unarchiveChannel method if channel ID length matches constants.

methods.name: onHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show to false.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with header, body, and footer including buttons for cancel and unarchive.
